memory: I believe that leadership in finance is not just about making decisions, but also about creating a culture of excellence and humanity. At Legend Investments, I have the privilege of overseeing a talented team of 180 professionals across various divisions. My leadership philosophy is built on three core pillars: empowerment, accountability, and continuous growth. By empowering my team members, I encourage them to take ownership of their work and explore innovative ideas. I also believe in holding everyone accountable for their actions and decisions. Additionally, I strongly advocate for continuous growth, both individually and collectively, as it drives us to stay ahead in the ever-evolving financial landscape. By fostering an open-door policy and actively seeking diverse perspectives, I've found that the most impactful ideas often arise from unexpected sources. To further facilitate collaboration and knowledge sharing, I host a weekly 'strategic roundtable' where team members from all levels can present their investment theses or operational improvements. It's been inspiring to see the creativity and dedication of my team members, such as the second-year analyst who proposed a novel approach to ESG scoring that we're now implementing across our portfolio. Leadership is not about having all the answers; it's about creating an environment where great ideas can flourish and everyone can contribute to our collective success.I believe that leadership in finance is not just about making decisions, but also about creating a culture of excellence and humanity.
